results.fact: Whether a self-issue permit is required/exists on this DNR land
results.correct_value: No permit of any kind; only a Discover Pass to park. There is no self-issue day-use permit at this DNR trailhead.
results.evidence: The DNR page for the Mount Si NRCA lists only a Discover Pass for parking and day-use-only rules, with no self-issue or day-use permit. The Mount Teneriffe hike page likewise lists only a Discover Pass. The row's own access.rules and top-level permit agree; access.permit's self-issue permit clause is the outlier. The group_limit of 12 matches DNR's NRCA rule that groups over 12 need a permit, so it was left alone.

results.fact: Distance and gain to Navaho Pass
results.correct_value: Navaho Pass is about 5.5 mi and about 3,000 ft of gain from the Stafford Creek trailhead
results.evidence: The Navaho Pass hike page gives 11 mi round trip (5.5 mi one way) and 3,000 ft of gain to the 6,000 ft pass. A trip log of the same trail puts the pass about 5 mi in (camp at 4.5 mi, pass under half a mile beyond), and a route record gives 13.7 mi round trip to the summit, roughly 5.8 mi to the pass. All reject the itinerary's 4.5 mi / 2,100 ft; the waypoint list (5.85 mi, 3,100 to 6,000 ft) agrees. The approach prose's 'around mile 5' is moved to 5.5 to match.

results.fact: Route stats (grade/pitches) blend two different named routes on the same wall (Jötnar vs. Bluebell)
results.correct_value: Top-level stats are Jötnar (VI 5.9 A3+, 16 pitches); the ROUTE BREAKDOWN is Bluebell's pitch sequence and is now labelled as such
results.evidence: The AAC report on Jötnar gives VI 5.9 A3+, 2,000 ft, 16 pitches (2020); a climbers' forum trip report titles it Jötnar VI 5.9 A3. The Bluebell route record lays out exactly the pitch_detail sequence: Toe P1-3, Shield P4-6, Roofs P7-8, Slab P9-11, Headwall P12-15 (P12 Big Overhang 5.13-), Summit P16-17 (5.8/5.9); the AAC Bluebell article confirms the 5.13- Big Overhang on the headwall. The minimal fix labels the breakdown as Bluebell's. Still open: which line this row should represent is a product decision, Bluebell's pitch count differs between sources (17 vs 21), and the '3D Dike' label in pitch_detail[2] belongs to the Shield (pitch 5 or 6), not P12-13 - not rewritten.
